sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five matches (W-D-W-W-W) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, while visitors Alsager Town are struggling near the foot of the division with just 4 points and have won only once in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a test away at Dawley Town in a mid-table clash that could be significant in the title race, with Stafford currently two points behind leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host Eccleshall in a match between strong performers—Bridgnorth are unbeaten in their last five despite a recent loss, while Eccleshall have been inconsistent. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a clash of mid-table sides, with Wolverhampton's recent win suggesting good form. Bilston Town (5th) travel to face Foley Meir in a match between teams separated by just one point. Barnton host Shawbury United, with Shawbury in dire form (five losses in their last six) facing a side riding recent momentum. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town in a bottom-half encounter where New Mills are slight favorites on recent form. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home, both struggling sides looking for improvement. Telford Town travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads in a match between two of the division's poorest performers, while Brereton Social host Widnes Town—the division's bottom club with just 2 points and winless in their last six matches.
